summary: Baseline verification executed for backend and frontend preview. Backend critical baseline (auth/register/login/me, duplicates/invalid credentials, protected routes, catalog total=189, forum create/reply/like persistence, orders checkout/history persistence) passed via pytest. Frontend mobile integration partially verified (login, shop reach, add-to-cart, cart qty update), but full scripted checkout/forum end-to-end was blocked by repeated selector ambiguity from duplicate mounted testIDs in web preview runtime.

integration_issues.issue: Multiple matching mounted elements for identical testIDs (e.g., top-bar-cart, cart-screen) caused non-deterministic Playwright resolution in Expo web runtime, stopping deterministic continuation after 3 retries.

action_items: Main agent: make critical testIDs unique to visible active screen context in web preview (or add screen-scoped wrappers) so automation can complete checkout+forum flows reliably.
Main agent: after forum redesign implementation, rerun full mobile UI baseline for checkout/order-history and forum create/reply/like persistence in one deterministic pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend route implementations for auth/forum/orders correctly enforce JWT on protected endpoints and consistently strip Mongo _id in responses.
Catalog seed baseline remains stable at total=189 and product pagination contract is intact.
Frontend data layer uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL and /api prefix consistently; no hardcoded localhost URLs found.

success_rate.frontend: 45% (critical flow partially validated before selector-blocked stop rule)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Do not rework same selectors repeatedly: prior run hit 3 retry stop rule around duplicated top-bar-cart/cart-screen selectors in web preview. Begin from login, then use strictly visible/scoped selectors and verify checkout + forum create/reply/like after testID uniqueness is improved.
rca_of_issue: RCA: Expo web stack keeps multiple route instances mounted with repeated identical testIDs, so generic selectors resolve to hidden/stale nodes. Reproduction: login -> account -> cart/shop -> click top-bar-cart and wait for cart-screen; locator resolves to multiple nodes and can timeout or click non-visible target. Mitigation: enforce unique per-screen testIDs or scope selectors to active route container.
